newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks sag on concern about IMF talks.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks sag on concern about IMF talks.

text.p: Pakistani stocks sagged in early trade on Thursday on uncertainty about the result of Pakistan-IMF talks on resuming a stalled standby loan, dealers said.
"The market has been hit by rumours that Pakistan's talks with the IMF did not prove positive," dealer Khalid Waheed said. "If these are true, there would be a major slide in the index."

The Karachi 100-share index fell 6.42 points, or 0.47 percent, to 1,355.08 after 45 minutes of trade. Losers led gainers 40 to 21. Lucky Cement fell 0.55 rupees to 8.70 and Pak State Oil 3.0 to 316. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
